current.title: 🚨 1.7.4 紧急修复：时间线只剩 2 个豆 / v1.7.4 hotfix — timeline showed only 2 dots
current.summary: ChatGPT 改版导致时间线只剩 2 个豆、顶栏按钮错位，1.7.4 已修；商店版预计 8 月 5 日前更新。
current.bodyMarkdown:
## 🚨 1.7.4 紧急修复

ChatGPT 最近又改了页面，把**屏幕外的整轮对话从页面里卸载掉了**（以前只清空内容、保留一个外壳）。插件一直靠那个外壳来数你的每一条提问，外壳没了，就出现了这些问题：

- **右侧时间线不管对话多长，都只剩 2 个豆**——看着像是对话"丢了"，其实只是插件找不到了。
- **导出的「选择导出」只能勾到眼前那两条消息**，往前的勾不到。
- **顶栏的公告按钮和导出按钮掉到第二行、还被裁掉一半**——这是同一次改版把按钮容器换成了一个特殊的包装层导致的。

这三个问题**已全部修好**：时间线改用每轮都存在的容器来定位，配合插件本来就抓到的对话数据识别哪些是提问轮，实测 123 条提问的长对话一条不落；没加载出来的那些轮，预览文字和点击跳转也都正常。顶栏五个按钮（分享 / 朗读 / 公告 / 导出 / 更多）回到同一排。顺手还修掉了豆标题里多出来的「你说：」前缀。

**📦 现在就想用**：去 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases) 下载 1.7.4 安装即可。
**⏳ Chrome / Edge 商店版预计 8 月 5 日前更新**，商店审核期间请先用 GitHub 版。

## 中文 — 常用功能

- **时间线 (Timeline)**：右侧紫色小豆豆，每条对话一个，鼠标悬浮看预览、点击跳转。
- **图钉 (Pins)**：长回答里点段落可以钉住，小豆豆上会显示钉子标记，上下箭头在同一段对话内的钉子之间切换。
- **收藏 / 收藏夹**：preview row 上点星标即可收藏；点悬浮面板底栏「Favorites」打开收藏夹，**跨对话**的收藏也能看。
- **导出对话**：右上角那个 ⬇ 按钮点开是个小菜单——「整个导出」一键导出当前对话，或「选择导出」勾选要的消息只导出那几条；格式在扩展弹窗「对话导出」一栏切换（标准 / 简化 Markdown、标准 / 简化 JSON、HTML）。
- **临时反悔（Undo temp）**：临时对话右上角的反悔按钮，一键把当前临时对话作为前情提要带到一段全新的正式对话里——不丢上下文。
- **Prompt 管理器**：右下角悬浮球，存提示词、tag、搜索、点一下复制或插入到输入框。
- **公式点击复制**：渲染好的公式直接点就复制 LaTeX；扩展弹窗里可切 LaTeX / MathML / 无美元符号 / Notion ($$) 几种格式。
- **自动隐藏官方右侧导航**：开着 Voyager 时间线时，自动把 ChatGPT 自带那条简陋的右侧 prompt 导航条藏掉，右边清爽不打架；关掉时间线它自己回来。
- **更温和的深色模式**：深色模式下把 ChatGPT 那刺眼的纯黑背景换成柔和的深灰（含 Codex 页面、底部输入框淡出带、代码块标题栏），扩展弹窗「外观」一栏开关，只在深色模式生效，默认关。
- **布局调整**：扩展弹窗里有滑块改聊天宽度、聊天字号、代码块字号、输入框宽度、侧边栏宽度。

## 反馈

有需求 / 发现 bug 欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues) 提一下。

---

## 🚨 Hotfix in 1.7.4

ChatGPT changed its page again and now **unmounts entire off-screen turns** from the DOM (it used to keep a wrapper and only empty the body). The extension counted your prompts through that wrapper, so when it disappeared:

- **The timeline showed only 2 dots, no matter how long the conversation was** — it looked like turns had gone missing; the extension just couldn't find them.
- **Export's "Select & export" could only reach those same two messages**, nothing further up.
- **The announcement and export buttons in the header dropped onto a second line and got clipped** — the same redesign moved them into a wrapper that stacks buttons vertically.

All three are **fixed**. The timeline now anchors on the wrapper that survives virtualisation and identifies user turns from conversation data the extension already captures — verified on a 123-prompt conversation with nothing missing; turns that aren't loaded still show their preview text and still navigate correctly. The five header buttons (share / read-aloud / announcement / export / options) are back on one row. Dot labels also no longer carry ChatGPT's screen-reader-only "you said:" heading.

**📦 Want it now**: grab 1.7.4 from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/releases).
**⏳ The Chrome / Edge store build is expected before August 5** — please use the GitHub build while it's in review.

## English — common features

- **Timeline** — Purple dots on the right side, one per turn. Hover to preview, click to jump.
- **Pins** — Pin specific paragraphs inside long answers; the dot shows a pin marker, up/down arrows cycle pins within the same turn.
- **Favorites** — Star any preview row; open the favorites panel from the floating panel's footer "Favorites" button — also works across conversations.
- **Conversation export** — The ⬇ button in the header opens a small menu: **Entire conversation** (one-click) or **Select & export** (tick messages, download only those). Pick a format in the popup's "Conversation export" section (standard / simplified Markdown, standard / simplified JSON, or HTML).
- **Undo temp** — A regret button in the top-right of every temporary chat. One click captures the whole temp conversation and hands it off to a fresh persistent chat — context preserved.
- **Prompt Manager** — Floating ball bottom-right. Stores prompts with tags + search; click to copy or insert.
- **Formula click-to-copy** — Click any rendered formula to copy its LaTeX. Format (LaTeX / MathML / no-dollar / Notion) configurable in the popup.
- **Auto-hide ChatGPT's native right-edge nav** — while Voyager's Timeline is on, the clunky native prompt-nav dashes are hidden automatically; turn the Timeline off and they come back.
- **Gentler dark mode** — swaps ChatGPT's harsh pure-black dark theme for soft dark grays (including Codex pages, the fade band above the composer and code-block headers). Toggle under *Appearance* in the popup; dark mode only, off by default.
- **Layout sliders** — Chat width, chat font size, code block font size, composer width, sidebar width — all in the extension popup.

## Feedback

Drop requests / bugs at [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/TanChuping/chatgpt-voyager/issues).
